sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift deployed, standing by in office for debrief with Team 2.
As debrief finished, received a response call from Red Radisson hotel regarding a female guest causing a disturbance inside and assaulting staff.

Arrived; female guest still causing disturbance to staff and other guests. Asked her to leave but she aggressively declined (belongings in a room); staff and security assisted her to retrieve belongings and escort her out.
Still standing by at Red Radisson, Police contacted.
As she continued to pack her belongings, issued her a verbal trespass for 2 years.
Police arrived and escorted the female out of Red Radisson. Security standing by for assistance.
Standby Red Radisson all clear. Full sweep Lorne Street all clear.
Arrived Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square all clear. Making way to HQ (low battery).
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male vagrant causing a disturbance; staff requested removal.
Arrived, approached the male vagrant causing the disturbance and asked him to vacate. Standing by.
Arrived HQ, charging ops phone (low battery).
Welfare check all stores on Queen Street; arrived Commercial Bay / Britomart, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, all stores welfare checked. Heading up Albert Street.
Albert Street check complete, welfare check Albert Mart clear. Heading to Cathedral.
St Patrick's Cathedral and Liston House quick sweep all clear. Heading up Federal Street.
Full sweep Federal Street, 77 Convenience store Victoria Street all clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Welfare check Mayoral Drive all clear.
Full sweep Aotea Square all clear. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.

Received a response call from Mountain Warehouse regarding a female vagrant who attempted theft and caused a massive disturbance; staff kicked her out and she walked down Queen Street with the stolen goods.
Arrived; store was closed but they opened it on our call. Given photo description and directions; swept down Queen Street but could not find her.
Received a response call from Sail Away Souvenirs regarding a female acting suspicious in the store grabbing merchandise near the exit.
Arrived; manager wanted her out. Escorted her out of the store and she complied.

Realised the female matched the description of the Mountain Warehouse thief. Repeatedly asked her to return the stolen merchandise; she answered very aggressively but eventually returned it. She was seen causing a disturbance to the public and trying to re-enter Mountain Warehouse; intervened and stopped her. Police called due to her assaulting one of the security staff.
Police arrived and took her into custody. Security on standby for assistance.
Security standby all clear. Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone.
Arrived HQ, charging ops phone (low battery).
Full sweep Upper Queen Street, McDonald's, Avanis Chicken, 77 Convenience store, BBQ Chicken, all clear. Standby.
Commencing full sweep Lorne Street and welfare check on stores still open.
Lorne Street full sweep all clear.
Full sweep High Street / Freyberg Place / Chancery Square all clear. Heading down Jean Batten Street to Fort Lane.
Arrived Fort Lane, welfare check on all stores, hotels etc, all clear.
Arrived Commercial Bay / Britomart, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by.
Received a response call from Jo & Joe regarding a female who caused a disturbance inside the premises.
Arrived; duty manager said they had escorted her out and she was in front of the entrance. Asked her to move herself and her belongings; she was fully compliant. Standing by.
Received a call from a Starbucks staff member asking to be walked to her car as she felt unsafe. Heading to the requested location.
Starbucks staff member safely guided to her destination. Heading back to HQ for break.
Received a response call from Britomart McDonald's regarding a group of teenagers causing a disturbance and making a mess.
Arrived; manager wanted them all out. Asked the group of male teenagers to leave; fully compliant. Standing by till they leave.
Group of teenagers left without further issues. Stand down, patrolling Queen Street till shift handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to night shift. Incident media (Red Radisson / Mountain Warehouse) on file. Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Card, 2 x Vest, 1 x Ops phone.
